subtopic: Variable Life Insurance Fees and Expenses
source_evidence: The amount of your premium payments that go into the account may be less than you paid because fees were taken out of the payments.
question: Misconception: Every dollar paid in premiums is invested in the policy account, so fees do not reduce the amount invested.
answer: Fees can be taken from premium payments, so less than the full premium may go into the account. Variable life insurance also has ongoing and transaction-based fees that can reduce the account’s value.
